review_notes.detail: 4A and 5A are SERV✲ VOLT symbols without A1 card portions. They remain distinct source objects.

P3 SET and P2 RESET feed separate cross-lane rails. GATE 5-9 feeds bit-9 B, GATE 9-11 feeds all A gates, and GATE 10-11 feeds bit-10/11 B gates. Source diamonds preserved at native entries and middle taps.
A gates have printed 4D10 second inputs; bit-9 B has 4B13, while bit-10/11 B have 4D10.
The B-side output gates and indicators are printed at 6D/7D, 6H/7H and 6M/7M; their row positions were checked against the native scan.
